title: Walker and the Cosmos Club

tellings.quote: >> Walker was Walker was one of the one of the people that's one of the things we discovered

plain: The UFO researcher Grant Cameron says that a man named Eric A. Walker was one of the people he and others discovered to be connected with the Cosmos Club, a private club in Washington, D.C. Cameron mentions it briefly as a finding of his research, without naming a source or saying more about what Walker did there. He brings it up because it would tie Walker to a circle of people involved in the government's handling of UFOs.
